settings.orderTerms:
Product illustrations are as viewed externally (from the outside). This Order Confirmation supercedes ALL previous quotes, e-mail correspondence and previous Order Confirmations for your project. Any necessary configuration or specification changes must be noted to avoid the specification of the delivered products potentially differing from your requirements.
* Please note, we will accept a photograph of the signed order confirmation, taken using a smart phone, sent to us as an email.
* All prices include any paint and all door hardware.
* Please note that images on the quotation do not resemble the actual look, size or proportions of the product - they are indicative of the configuration of the specified products
* Lead times commence on receipt of signed order confirmation.
* Please note that no allowance has been made for the provision of mechanical or powered lifting equipment, unless explicitly stated.
* Please do not book any following trades until all products are installed as we cannot be held responsible for any costs incurred as lead times may vary.
